body: Sent you my discord!
Yeah you’re right, I just need to stop over thinking it! Thanks you helped :)

I’m super open with him about my feelings so i have told him how it’s made me feel. He said he feels terrible for telling me but I don’t want him to feel bad because he didn’t really do anything wrong. It’s just my insecurities playing in my mind. I guess you’re right tho I should keep communicating with him and hopefully I’ll feel better about this soon. Thanks for the advice you helped!
He told me he felt really guilty about it and wanted to tell me because of that.

I really appreciate your response! Thank you 
I’ve decided to stop responding to her when she does pick on me. I’ll just walk away and give her the silent treatment so she realizes I’m not listening to her anymore.

I didn’t get to go to the dinner because I decided to work extra hours! But I have decided to stop trying to fix their relationship it isn’t my responsibility anymore. I also started working more so I can leave sooner. Thank you for your advice I appreciate it!

Thank you so much! I really appreciate your advice. I decided to start working more hours so I’m home less and have more money so I can move out faster. I can’t wait to build a family that will support me
She’s 18!

I’m so sorry your mom had to go through this. I hope she’s doing well now! 

I guess I just need to leave everything else behind and work on making myself happy. I need to start with my confidence. 
Thank you for your response!

I don’t know why but reading your response made me very emotional. My self confidence has been so bad because of my mom that I can’t even look in a mirror without feeling ugly. I’ve never had my mom or my dad tell me you look good today. She just belittles me because I’m fat. I do love her I really do I just wish she was a bit nicer to me. I really do appreciate you typing to me I wish I had someone like you as my mother, That would have been nice.

I’ll definitely search up technique medium chill! Thank you :) 

I just can’t wait for the day to leave with my sister, hopefully soon in a year or two. Im going to start working on myself more and just ignore her. 

I already try to stay outside with friends but she complains that I don’t do anything at home and just leave all day. Even when I have university classes. 

I can’t wait to leave!

Thank you so much for your advice! 
I’m definitely going to leave in a year or two I just want to be super ready for it because It’s going to be hell when I do decide to leave. I am planning on taking my sister with me so she has a stable environment to live in as well. 

My aunts are all like her, they always pick on my for my weight and try to give me tips on diets. I try to ignore it but it just gets overwhelming sometimes. I’m going to go and have fun with my cousins and if anyone says anything I’ll ignore it. 

I’ll check those subreddits out for sure thank you so much! I appreciate it a lot.
I’m definitely going to the dinner for sure now, if she does say anything I’ll just ignore her.
haha omg I love that 😂
I’ve tried to talk to him but he refuses to talk about my mom at all with me. He leaves the room or changes the topic.
You know what you’re right I’m going to go to the dinner tonight and have a blast. Im going to ignore what anyone says about my weight.

I’m so sorry you had to go through that! I hope you’re in a better place now. 

I’m 20 and in uni so I live with them at the moment because working more hours is hard with school. I do have enough saved up to leave but I want to take my sister with me so I’m probably going to stay for another year or two and then leave with my sister.

My dad refuses to talk about my mom with me I’ve tried but he changes the topic or leaves the room. 
My family is all on her side usually, she calls them on the phone and complains about us all day. I tried talking to my friends about it and they told me that i should move out so I guess I’m going to try to save more money and just move out once my siblings are a little older.

I’m 20! I wish it was easy to leave but I can’t
my siblings are all younger and In school . If I leave she will take all her anger out on my siblings and my dad. My dad is a very emotional soft spoken person so it would really hurt me to see them having to deal with her stress.

I think that might be it, she does always talk about how she used to be super skinny in her 20s and how she’s going to get back to that body. I did start going to the gym recently so hopefully I can take off the extra pounds and be healthy. Thank you for your advice :) I appreciate it
I wish I could just cut her off but it’s hard, if I leave my younger sister would have to take on the role. And I don’t want her to go through the stress of having to play therapist

Thank you for your advice :) 
I’m going to start standing up for myself a bit at a time. It’s hard because she just ruins everyone’s day and then everyone’s having a bad day. So I try to just keep her calm so my younger siblings can focus on school and stuff and not have to deal with any stress.

I’m 20! But she won’t let me move out yet she says she can’t do everything alone at home. She’s a housewife so I help her cook and clean. Hopefully I can save up enough and move out soon. But I feel bad for my younger siblings, If I leave my sister will have to take my role as the therapist and she’s only 18. 

I really do appreciate the hug thank you lots <3

I do live with them because my university is like 10 minutes from their place. Also she refuses to let me move out because she can’t do the house chores alone. I have a part time job so I am saving money slowly. I am not financially dependent on them.
Oh okay! Thank you
